major_cooldowns.name: Dark Transformation
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use strictly on cooldown alongside Apocalypse.

major_cooldowns.name: Apocalypse
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use precisely after casting Dark Transformation, ensuring the target has at least 4 Festering Wounds.

major_cooldowns.name: Summon Gargoyle
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use as your primary 3-minute burst cooldown, syncing perfectly with Dark Transformation and Apocalypse.

major_cooldowns.name: Abomination Limb
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use during your burst windows for passive damage and constant grips/Runic Corruption.

defensives.name: Anti-Magic Shell
defensives.usage_rule: Use proactively to absorb magic damage and prevent application of magical debuffs.

defensives.name: Icebound Fortitude
defensives.usage_rule: Use to reduce all damage taken by 30% and immune stun effects.

defensives.name: Death Strike
defensives.usage_rule: Use as a Runic Power dump to heal after taking significant damage.

rules.action: Always cast Dark Transformation immediately followed by Apocalypse.
Ensure the target has exactly 4 or more Festering Wounds before casting Apocalypse.
During Summon Gargoyle, spam Death Coil or Epidemic to feed Runic Power to the Gargoyle, increasing its damage.
Avoid casting Festering Strike if the target already has 4+ Festering Wounds to prevent overcapping.

source_summary: Unholy Death Knight has massive setup-heavy burst sequences. The goal is to stack pets (Gargoyle, Army of the Dead/Apocalypse, and the Dark Transformation ghoul) and rapidly spend Runic Power to feed the Gargoyle's damage.
